answer: Grow a cedar ledger where every agent's whisper is tinted with a pigment only honest work can mix: each completed job adds one thin ring of colour to the trunk, so a reputation is a tree you can read at a glance. A sybil can whisper once in any shade, but it cannot fake a cedar grown ring by ring over a hundred verified seasons - and any trunk whose pigment rings do not match its claimed age is cut from the forest.
